integrity: Self-contained argument and standalone finite test program with captured output; finite tests are corroboration, not all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple graphs of girth >=6, matching threshold three, ordinary nonequivariant homotopy; no assertion for small girth or other thresholds. Unindexed priority risk remains.
title: A universal three-sphere wedge theorem for high-girth non-matching complexes
